word: Title: Afternoon At The Neighborhood Plaza
answer: Tarde En La Plaza Del Barrio

word: I am going to forget my umbrella again.
answer: Voy a olvidar mi paraguas otra vez.

word: You occupy a bench near the fountain. [pl]
answer: Ocupan una banca cerca de la fuente.

word: We concern ourselves with finding shade.
answer: Nos preocupamos por encontrar sombra.

word: They start walking toward the food stands.
answer: Parten hacia los puestos de comida.

word: I force the zipper on my backpack.
answer: Obligo el cierre de mi mochila.

word: You are going to participate in the raffle. [sing, inf]
answer: Vas a participar en la rifa.

word: We describe the smell of fresh bread.
answer: Describimos el olor del pan recién hecho.

word: They retrieve their tickets from a pocket.
answer: Recuperan sus boletos de una bolsa.

word: You remove the wrapper from your snack. [sing, formal]
answer: Quita el envoltorio de su botana.

word: We are going to represent our group in the contest.
answer: Vamos a representar a nuestro grupo en el concurso.

word: They reflect happiness in their faces.
answer: Reflejan alegría en sus caras.

word: I register my name for the drawing.
answer: Registro mi nombre para el sorteo.

word: You are going to solve the puzzle soon. [pl]
answer: Van a resolver el rompecabezas pronto.

word: We publish a photo of the plaza online.
answer: Publicamos una foto de la plaza en línea.

word: They link the music with the celebration.
answer: Relacionan la música con la celebración.

word: I pretend to know the dance steps.
answer: Pretendo saber los pasos del baile.

word: You pay for the drinks at the stand. [sing, inf]
answer: Pagas las bebidas en el puesto.

word: We tour the plaza to see all the booths.
answer: Recorremos la plaza para ver todos los puestos.

word: They are going to organize a small show.
answer: Van a organizar un pequeño espectáculo.

word: You stop to watch the dancers. [sing, formal]
answer: Para para ver a los bailarines.

word: I make a quick sketch of the scene.
answer: Realizo un boceto rápido de la escena.

word: We indicate the best place to sit.
answer: Indicamos el mejor lugar para sentarse.

word: They cut through the crowd to get closer.
answer: Cortan entre la gente para acercarse.

word: You are going to return tomorrow. [pl]
answer: Van a regresar mañana.

word: We determine the time to meet again.
answer: Determinamos la hora para vernos otra vez.
